remarks: ADORABLE COUNTRY COTTAGE WITH STORYBOOK CHARM IN SANTA SUSANA KNOLLS! Nestled beneath magnificent mature trees, this enchanting two-bedroom cottage is truly a little slice of heaven! With its striking navy-blue exterior, crisp white trim, inviting front porch, and picturesque setting, This home is bursting with character and curb appeal! Step inside to discover a warm, welcoming interior featuring fresh paint, updated flooring, smooth ceilings, newer fixtures, and undeniable cottage charm. The inviting living room flows into an expanded, remodeled kitchen with generous counter space, plentiful cabinetry, and a separate dining area.
